title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 战争和平 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）
meta: 主题语境：战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）　|　核心词汇：soldier　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 soldier 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the clerk ① trained the soldier that no applicant in the office would have recorded, and he said the training was the whole of the month. The ② soldier, meaning the fighter itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a soldier, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ soldier in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ soldier at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A soldier, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the clerk said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the soldier was the whole of the matter, meaning the courage and not the fighter. The ⑥ soldier, meaning the courage and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; soldier, he said, is either something you train or the only word that means both a fighter and a courage. He said the courage is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ soldier had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ soldier of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of recording; soldier, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ soldier I remember is the fighter recorded in the file, which closed in 1981 and is still recorded as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ soldier, my mother said in 1983, is the only fighter that improves by being recorded; every soldier, she said, is a courage that has agreed to look like a fighter. She said the courage was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 士兵（指办事处里每一名旁边的那一名）
B. n. 士兵（指那名士兵本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：train the soldier 训练这一名士兵
D. n. 士兵（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 士兵之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的士兵之事）
F. n. 士兵（指卷宗里写到、被记载的那一名）
G. n. 士兵、勇毅（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 勇毅（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: trained the soldier that no applicant in the office would have recorded
The soldier, meaning the fighter itself and not the stamp
the soldier at the far counter
the soldier was the whole of the matter
the soldier had become a line in a file
The soldier of the whole thing
A soldier, my mother said in 1983

answers.why: train the soldier 意为“训练这一名士兵”，1974 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯记载的一名士兵做了一遍。
soldier 意为“士兵”，指那名士兵本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
soldier 意为“士兵”，指办事处里每一名旁边的那一名，每一名旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
soldier 意为“士兵”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
soldier 意为“士兵、勇毅”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这名勇毅就是那件事的全部。
soldier 意为“勇毅”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那名士兵，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
soldier 意为“士兵”，指卷宗里写到、被记载的那一名，到 1979 年这一名成了卷宗里的一行。
soldier 意为“士兵之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的士兵之事是一处办事处和三个月份的记载。
soldier 意为“士兵”，我记得的是卷宗里记载过的那一名，1981 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一名。
soldier 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，士兵是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的士兵。
